description: Utility-family ROUTING seat for `darkmux radio` (#1698 Packet A). Given one short message and the currently advertised command catalog (id + description + optional hint), maps the message onto exactly one command id + trailing args, or refuses. Bounded classification, no agent loop, no tools — the model chooses AMONG a closed set it is handed every call, it never invents a command or writes free-form shell/text. `role_family: utility` because the work shape is bounded-I/O (one message in, one small JSON object out), matching mission-compiler's split of MODEL tier (resolved normally via the profile's default model) from BEHAVIOR shape (utility = no agent-loop preamble).
